architecture.backend: Python (all ingestion, normalization, dedupe, LLM tagging, scheduling)
architecture.frontend: Next.js (search UI only, consumes Python API)
architecture.note: Overrides brain/01-architecture.md routing rule. Python backend is long-running (no serverless timeout), so quota-aware staggered scheduling is done here.

scheduler.engine: APScheduler or celery-beat inside Python backend
scheduler.strategy: On each tick, run ONLY sources that are (a) cron-due, (b) have remaining quota in every applicable window, (c) not in backoff, (d) have required env keys present. Never trigger all sources at once.
scheduler.usage_tracking: Persist per-source request counts per window in DB (source_quota_usage table); check before EVERY request, not just per run.
scheduler.safety_margin_note: For third_party/etiquette/unknown limits, budget = 80% of reported quota. Official limits may use up to 90%.
scheduler.monthly_quota_policy: Spread evenly: daily_allowance = ceil(monthly_budget / days_in_month). Never burst a monthly quota.
scheduler.shared_ip_bucket_policy: Sources with scope=global_ip share ONE bucket across all company tenants; never run two of them in parallel.
scheduler.http_429_policy: Honor Retry-After header. 3 consecutive 429s -> exponential backoff (1h, 2h, 4h ... max 24h) AND halve that source's daily_budget until a clean run.
scheduler.caching: Use ETag / If-Modified-Since on RSS and feed endpoints; a 304 costs no quota budget and skips processing.
scheduler.missing_keys_policy: If a source's required env vars are absent, skip it silently and log status=skipped_no_key (do not fail the tick).
scheduler.logging: Every request logged to source_runs (source_id, started_at, requests_used, fetched, inserted, dup counts, http_status, error). Feeds the video + cost numbers.

groups.name: Monthly hard-capped APIs (scarcest quota)
groups.policy: Trigger rarely, spread across the month. Gap-fillers only — never depend on these for the 200-post baseline.

groups.name: Daily-quota keyed APIs
groups.policy: One staggered batch run per day, well under the daily cap. These are the primary volume drivers.

groups.name: Hourly/per-minute quota APIs (generous)
groups.policy: Daily runs far below hourly caps; per-request delay respects the per-minute limit.

groups.name: Keyless feeds with published polling etiquette or unknown limits
groups.policy: 1-2 polls/day max, cache with ETag, always attribute. Unknown limits => conservative self-imposed budget.

groups.name: Public ATS board APIs — no published read limit
groups.policy: Self-impose ~1 req/s per host, one platform per time slot, daily. Highest-quality India data (direct from employer).

groups.name: Keyless but IP-rate-limited / anti-bot fronted
groups.policy: Strict GLOBAL per-IP budget shared across all tenants of the platform. Slow, sequential, off-peak slots. Disable on repeated blocks.

blocklist_note: Code-level guard: BeepRadar never fetches these domains (incl. subdomains and redirect targets), and direct scraping of them (e.g. JobSpy) stays disabled. Exception approved 2026-11-20: paid/licensed data feeds may contribute job records; their URLs are stored for attribution/link-back only via RawJob.licensedFeed=true and are never fetched. Covered feeds: SerpApi Indeed/Glassdoor, RapidAPI LinkedIn Job Search, Fantastic.jobs direct API, CleanJobData, and the configured paid Apify Actors (parsebird/naukri-jobs-scraper, crawloop/internshala-scraper, crawloop/foundit-jobs-scraper). Unauthorized direct scrapers remain disabled and their URLs are still filtered.

verification_checklist: Adzuna: confirm real limits in account dashboard after signup (third-party numbers may be stale)
Jooble: confirm whether 100/day or 500-lifetime cap applies to your key
JSearch / Active Jobs DB: confirm free-plan quotas on RapidAPI pricing page on signup day
SerpApi: confirm 250 searches/month on plan page; verify engine params (l for indeed_jobs, location for google/glassdoor) on first live run
HireBase RapidAPI: confirm host hirebase-jobs-data.p.rapidapi.com and 500-jobs/month allowance in the dashboard
RapidAPI LinkedIn: confirm host linkedin-job-search-api.p.rapidapi.com, /active-jb path and monthly Jobs credits in the dashboard

Fantastic.jobs direct: confirm the dashboard key works against data.fantastic.jobs with FANTASTIC_JOBS_API_KEY, and verify how the 500 included jobs are counted on the first live run (100 requests / 14 days trial)
JobsPipe: confirm free monthly credits and that limit=25 is accepted on the subscribed plan
Apify actors: confirm subscribed Actor access and per-result pricing in the Apify dashboard; verify monitorMode store names on first run
Careerjet: confirm v4 endpoint params + any quota in publisher agreement
The Muse: confirm keyless access + current limits (official docs 403 to bots)
Remotive: find exact India location slug (probe returned wrong rows)
Workable / Workday / Oracle: probe from production IP, watch for CF 1015 / 429, adjust global budgets
Breezy / BambooHR / Pinpoint / Rippling / Comeet / JazzHR: verify exact endpoint paths per tenant before production
All ATS tokens: run probe script, keep only 200-with-India-jobs tokens in data/ats_tokens.json
Reddit: check OAuth free-tier status (reported shutdown March 2027) before registering app
Record verification date per source in DB (sources.verified_at) — feeds the video
